summary: Access map lines stay in place, and admins scheduled for later no longer cause false failures.

fixes.title: Access map lines stay in place
fixes.text: Clicking Remove access or Give access twice threw the lines across the board. The map now redraws its lines once the layout has settled.

fixes.title: No false failures for future admins
fixes.text: Memberships for an admin scheduled for a later date were reported as missing from the tenant. They now wait and are applied right after the account is created.
